summary: Iteration 3 - Tested new Results + Attendance features end-to-end. Backend: 32/32 pytest passed (auth gate, all 14 grade-boundary cases, results CRUD + case-insensitive lookup, attendance CRUD + validation, stats includes results/attendance). Frontend: 10/11 admin+public flows passed; the single 'failure' is a test-script artifact (CSS uppercase on exam_name) - feature itself works correctly.

issues: exam_name is rendered with CSS .uppercase class; DOM text is preserved but visually all-caps. Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:362 _norm() handles None safely (good). Lookup queries use indexed-friendly equality on roll_number_norm + student_class_norm but no compound index is created - add db.results.create_index([('roll_number_norm',1),('student_class_norm',1)]) for scale.

server.py:380 admin_create_result silently strips subjects with empty name but does NOT validate marks_obtained <= max_marks. A subject like {max:50, obtained:100} will be accepted - results in >100% percentages. Recommend per-subject validation.
server.py:386 _compute_result_totals divides by total_max; protected by 'if total_max else 0' so safe. Good.
server.py:426 attendance validation rejects total_days<=0 and present_days<0/>total - good (returns 400).
Pydantic ResultSubject does not constrain max_marks > 0 nor marks_obtained >= 0 - negative values would pass.
admin.html addSubject() seeds 3 rows by default; createResult filters subjects to those with max_marks > 0, which is safe.

results.html / attendance.html lookup endpoints are unauthenticated (by design for student lookup). Roll+class is essentially a low-entropy guess; consider rate-limiting to prevent enumeration of student data.
Header desktop breakpoint correctly moved from md: to lg: in renderLayout - good fix to prevent nav overflow when 6 links + Admin + CTA are shown.

data-testid coverage on new pages is solid (results-form, results-roll, results-class, results-submit, result-card-<id>, results-empty, attendance-* counterparts, sidebar-results, sidebar-attendance, result-form, result-submit, attendance-admin-form, etc.).
Frontend admin uses confirm() dialog for deletes - acceptable for an admin tool but not ideal UX.

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional (10/10 features verified; 1 test assertion was wrong, not a real bug)

rca of the issue: No app bugs. STEP6 frontend assertion failed because results.html renders exam_name inside a div with Tailwind's 'uppercase' class - Playwright's inner_text() returns rendered (uppercased) text. The data is correctly stored and displayed; my test assertion compared mixed-case 'TEST_E2E_Exam' to displayed 'TEST_E2E_EXAM'. Functional flow (admin publishes -> public lookup card appears with correct student/roll/class/exam) works perfectly. No action needed.
